text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's summer! And summer means beach!
And beach means training
camp! Full
speed ahead! Off to camp! Go, go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer is here, and with it the summer
training camp. Our bus sets
out. Its
destination: the sparkling seaside.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No duh! This summer is my big chance! ♪
By the time we get back, I'm
gonna be
faster than Prez!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll be so strong, she'll be shocked, and
shower me with praise, and
pat my head,
and oh yeah! You'll be proud of me too,
won't you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So once we're there, hit me with the
roughest regimen you got! Oh,
but before
that... ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Time for a song! 'Scuse me, could you pass
the mic? This is number
one Teio, singing
her number one song!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, Teio dives right in to her
summer training with the same
passion that
she sang karaoke with.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Bam bam bam bam! Beach dashes are too
easy! I could do this all day!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, how's my form? Make sure you're
paying attention. I'm
counting on you, all
right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
A slope! Mountain trails are always all
bumpy and fun! C'mon, let's go,
with a
hop, skip, and a jump!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You are coming, aren't you? It's no fun alone. Once we get to the top, we can have a picnic!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, after that run I'm in the mood for
fireworks! Look, Trainer, I'm
a spinny
firework! Spinny spin spin!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You're supposed to jump up and
down! Like this—hup, hah,
whoo! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's making the most of training camp,
that's for sure. And I'm along
for the entire
exhilarating ride...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Morning! Let's keep up the energy today!
Whoo! More running
together, and
swimming, and...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh? Trainer? Traineeer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I come to, I find myself lying on the
cold wooden floor.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer, you're awake. You scared me
to death, fainting like that
all of a sudden.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Like thirty minutes? So training's not over
yet! If we pick up the pace,
we can make
up for lost time. Today's gonna be fun! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But why'd you pass out anyway? Not
enough sleep?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! You were so excited, you
couldn't sleep, and played
games all
night? Hehe, I'm kinda guilty of that too...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What's with the silent treatment? Was I
spot on? Heh, sleepovers are
always
exciting, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But wait a sec... Trainer, I didn't think you
were the type to get all
hyper. Yeah, that
doesn't seem like you... Ah!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Was it my fault you passed out? Because
I've been draggin you
around?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so that's why... I totally forgot you're
not an Umamusume. Thanks
for sticking it
out...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We can't afford to take a day off. Her
ambition wouldn't allow it
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just gotta fight through it...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I'll take today off.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Don't "huh" me! I said, I'll take today off, and I mean it! The whole day!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Look how pale you still are—you'll get sick
if you move around. So
I've made up my
mind. No training today!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nngh... Well, we might fall a bit behind on
that goal, but that's okay!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Without you tagging along, there's no one
to train me anyway. Plus,
it... just wouldn't
be like me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I dunno exactly what, but something about
it just doesn't feel right.
Prez would
probably go off on her own no problem...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But I'd rather go with company. I mean...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the summer heat and the buzzing
of the cicadas, Teio voices
her honest
thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What I really want is to have fun. Just
winning isn't enough—I want to
win in
style, with pride, and be praised for it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Just like when I got a perfect score on that
dance game. I want to
share the moment.
With my friends, and you. Plus...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, who knows what kind of trouble I'll
run into down the road. I
mean, I'm pretty
invincible, but there are hurdles even I
can't get over
alone.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Like, remember when I lifted way too much
weight, and you stepped
in to help? Just
like that.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Prez might be fine all by herself, but I think being with other people is what makes me me, if that makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Which is all to say, I can't do this without
you. I'd fail so fast. So, um...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Let's take it easy today, yeah? Ahem.
Maybe you should pace
yourself a little,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you remembered. Well, that's
payback! ♪ Thanks to you, I
learned not
to push myself too hard, so now it's your
turn!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh! How about I give you a massage this
time?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Here goes! Tickle tickle tickle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For a moment, we forget all about training
and simply have fun. And
once the
moment has passed...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, since we're taking today off,
I have an idea...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wanna check out tonight's festival? I bet
it'll be tons of fun. Right?
Right?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yay! It's decided then! All right, let's play
and eat the night away!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, everything's so bright and sparkly!
Hey hey, Trainer! Let's buy
some masks
and try them on! Which one do you want?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Two masks, please! I'll take the pink
Hangout Ranger mask!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her cheerful voice seems to rise above the
clamor. Running, playing,
laughing—Teio
dashes through her summer training camp
in style.
